precommitted_rules.acceptance_time: SEC index Accepted timestamps are recorded verbatim as EDGAR-displayed values (EDGAR operates on US Eastern time); no silent timezone conversion.
precommitted_rules.acquirer_filed_documents: Acquirer- or third-party-filed documents record filer CIK and subject CIK separately from the SEC index company blocks.
precommitted_rules.ads_mapping: For ADS issuers, record the listed instrument, ADS-to-ordinary ratio and underlying class from the primary cover/registration source. Whether an ADS satisfies the panel common_equity membership contract is NOT decided in this pass; it is returned to root as a design question. No share-count/valuation conversion is implied.
precommitted_rules.issuer_copies: A current issuer IR copy or PDF matching an earlier 2026 capture hash shows unchanged bytes since that capture only; it is not original-version evidence. 8-K EX-99 is the original-version anchor; IR copies are corroboration, never a second independent disclosure.
precommitted_rules.membership_listing: A 10-K/10-Q cover Section 12(b) table is dated exchange-listing evidence for its own filing date only; it never alone establishes IPO date or uninterrupted listing. Initial listing prefers Form 8-A12B / 424B4 / effectiveness. Membership status per observation records the nearest dated evidence before and after the observation date and leaves continuity unresolved unless a change source (Form 25, 8-K Item 3.01, Form 15) is reviewed.
precommitted_rules.no_hit: A search or filing-list absence is never a negative. Labels remain unknown unless a separately reviewed admission passes.
precommitted_rules.non_text_items: Frame-wide: every GRAPHIC, XBRL data file, PDF or other non-HTML/non-text item listed in an SEC filing index is recorded as a census item. Data files are listed from the index and not fetched. Graphics/PDFs may be fetched and hash-bound but remain open (unreviewed) unless a recorded visual/format review exists. Successful decoding or text extraction is never a complete material-corpus review.
precommitted_rules.prior_control_exclusion: Listed at observation date but a definitive whole-company control agreement was already announced and not yet terminated before the observation date.
precommitted_rules.reverse_merger_test: For a merger where the listed issuer is legal survivor and target holders receive a majority: record separately (i) legal survivor/issuer, (ii) pro forma economic ownership with its exact primary-source sentence and basis (fully diluted, pre-adjustment), (iii) board/management control terms if stated, (iv) operating-business continuity (whose pipeline continues). Tag reverse_merger_control_candidate; never auto-admit to the whole-company pharma acquisition class, never a positive or negative label in this pass.
precommitted_rules.review_depth: Per document: full_text_read (entire extracted text read by the reviewer), targeted_sections_only (named sections read; remainder open), captured_unread (open), or not_captured (open). Only full_text_read closes a document. No category implies corpus completeness.
precommitted_rules.risk_set_exclusion: Third category distinct from negative and censored: issuer not an exchange-listed member at the observation date, evidenced by a primary delisting/deregistration source (Form 25, 8-K Item 3.01/5.01/2.01 completion, Form 15) dated before the observation date.
precommitted_rules.uk_takeover_code: A UK Takeover Code firm-offer (Rule 2.7) or scheme announcement is a discovery lead only until the existing definitive-control contract is independently satisfied.
